svg.title: Map of Egypt’s main ports
svg.desc: Map of Egypt showing the Mediterranean and Red Sea coasts, the Nile and its delta, the Suez Canal, and the ports of Alexandria, Dekheila, Damietta, Port Said and Ain Sokhna, with Cairo for reference.
